admission.justification: The lexer, name reader, declaration scanner and binding adapter share the source extent contract so symbol anchors and the scope walk use the same written declaration.

applicability: Source-written named declarations in a Lean file available to the paired code reader.
conditions: The shipped source scan has the file's recorded UTF-8 bytes.
An established full name requires agreement on namespace qualification across retained scope readings.
exclusions: Generated Lean declarations and unnamed instances.
Declarations whose extent or spelling requires elaboration beyond the shipped scan.
statement: The Lean reader preserves source-written names and complete declaration extents, and binds full names where scope is known.
